column1: # Patterns of the multi-tenant web hosting profiles cageweb, cagebash,
# cagedash and docker-hosted that contain an AppArmor variable or an
# pkg/sentry/confine's reference corpus covers the patterns with neither,
# so those are not repeated here.
#   1. the pattern as the profile writes it
#   2. the pattern with its variables replaced, as the parser reports it
#   3. the regexp the parser compiles it to
# The variables are @{PROC}, defined as /proc/ by tunables/proc, which
# tunables/global includes, and @{WWW_DIRS}, defined by the profiles
# themselves. The test defines both itself, with the same values: it has
# no host policy to read them from.
# Generated with apparmor_parser 4.0.1, one pattern at a time, so that
# the dumped rules cannot be confused for one another: the parser dumps
# them sorted by pattern rather than in the order they were written. For
# each pattern in the first column, write /tmp/refprofile, replacing
# and dump what it compiles to:
# The dump writes "aare: <pattern>   ->   <regexp>", which supplies the
# second and third columns. The profile name produces an "aare:" line of
# its own, "aare: refprofile   ->   refprofile", which is not a pattern
